mcat_description.short: Industrial Sheds are large prefabricated or fabricated steel structures used for manufacturing, warehousing, and storage operations, sold as turnkey construction projects or as supply-and-erect packages, typically quoted per square foot of covered area.
mcat_description.long: Industrial Sheds in the Indian market are predominantly Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB) — steel portal-frame structures with factory-fabricated columns, rafters, purlins, and colour-coated roofing panels assembled on-site, designed to IS 800-2007, IS 875, and IS 1893 codes for structural, wind, and seismic loads. They are also supplied as conventional MS fabricated sheds, tin/corrugated sheet sheds (teen shed / patra shed), FRP sheds, and PUF sandwich panel structures, covering spans from 10 m to 100 m and eave heights from 20 ft to 40 ft. Primary structural steel conforms to IS 2062 E250 grade, with roofing sheets in pre-painted Alum/Zinc alloy coated steel (0.5 mm nominal, silicon polyester finish) or polycarbonate/PUC sheets for daylighting. Buyers range from SME manufacturers and logistics operators to large industrial groups, procuring sheds for factories, godowns, workshops, cold storage, and vehicle parking.

market_context: Industrial Sheds in India are dominated by the Pre-Engineered Building (PEB) format, where factory-fabricated steel components (IS 2062 E250 grade) are assembled on-site to IS 800-2007 and IS 875 structural codes, offering construction timelines of 16–22 weeks versus 30+ weeks for conventional RCC builds. The market spans a wide product spectrum: PEB portal-frame sheds at the premium end, conventional MS fabricated sheds, and simpler corrugated sheet structures (locally called 'teen shed' or 'patra shed') at the entry level, with FRP and PUF sandwich panel sheds serving specialised applications (cold storage, clean rooms). India is among the fastest-growing PEB markets globally, driven by the Make in India initiative, growth in logistics and warehousing, and SME manufacturing expansion. Buyers consistently compare on clear span width, eave height, roofing sheet type, and cost per sq ft; the dominant transaction unit across all sub-segments is per sq ft of covered area. Key Indian PEB manufacturers include EPACK Prefab, Metal Tree, Pressmach, Kirby Building Systems, and Zamil Steel India. Structural design must comply with IS 800-2007 (general steel construction), IS 875 Parts 1–3 (dead, live, wind loads), and IS 1893 (seismic design) — these are the BIS codes buyers and specifiers reference when evaluating suppliers.
